200.answer: Package your satellite TV receiver securely, including all manuals and accessories. Attach the prepaid shipping label to the outside of the box. Drop off your package at a Purolator drop-off location or Canada Post outlet. You can also arrange a Purolator pick-up.

snippets.text: Drop off your package at the shipper listed on your shipping label: Purolator drop-off locations accepting QR codes Purolator drop-off locations accepting preprinted shipping labels You can also arrange a Purolator pick-up by calling the number found on the return label or downloading the Purolator app on your mobile device. Canada Post outlets If you don't have a prepaid shipping label: Visit the Bell equipment return portal to request a prepaid return shipping label. Depending on what you are returning, you will need your Internet and/or TV account number. Refer to the links below for instructions on returning each type of equipment. Internet account number (b1 or b2 number) Fibe or Satellite TV account number Once your request is submitted, you will receive an email with a scannable QR code that acts as your prepaid shipping label. If you have access to a printer, the email also contains a link to print out the shipping label. Package the equipment so that it can be shipped safely (a box is recommended).
